## ShipmentTracker — Blazor Web App (Auto Interactivity)

**Architecture choices:**
| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|

| Snappy after load | WebAssembly (no server round-trips) |
| Global users / latency | Auto mode (Server → WASM handoff) |
| Interactive controls everywhere | `@rendermode InteractiveWebAssembly` |
| Authentication | ASP.NET Core Identity (Individual accounts) |

- `/shipments` — Dispatcher dashboard: filterable list, inline status updates, create new shipments
- `/track` — Customer tracking: search by tracking number, progress bar, estimated delivery countdown

│   ├── Pages/Track.razor     (customer view)
